title: Psalm 93: The LORD Reigns Above the Floods
summary: The psalm proclaims that the LORD reigns, robed in majesty and armed with strength, so that the world is firmly established. His throne has stood from long ago, and he himself is from all eternity. The floods and seas lift up their roaring voices, but the LORD on high is mightier than them all, and his testimonies are sure and his house adorned with holiness forever.

from.where: The Study Bible's notes on Psalm 47
from.text: It is one of the enthronement psalms, a group (usually 47, 93, and 95 to 99) that celebrate the LORD as king.

from.where: The Study Bible's notes on Psalm 93
from.text: Psalm 93 is a hymn of God's kingship

line: The LORD reigns, robed in majesty; the floods lift up their roar, and the LORD on high is mightier than them all.
guide: Name the floods roaring in your life; the psalm does not say the waters are quiet, only that God is higher still. Say its first words aloud when you are afraid, not as a feeling but as a fact to stand on while the waves still pound.

stanzas.title: The LORD reigns, robed in majesty, from eternity
The floods lift their voice; the LORD is mightier
Sure testimonies and a holy house

verses.t: The LORD reigns! He is robed in majesty; the LORD has clothed and armed Himself with strength. The world indeed is firmly established; it cannot be moved.
Your throne was established long ago; You are from all eternity.
The floodwaters have risen, O LORD; the rivers have raised their voice; the seas lift up their pounding waves.
Above the roar of many waters— the mighty breakers of the sea— the LORD on high is majestic.
Your testimonies are fully confirmed; holiness adorns Your house, O LORD, for all the days to come.
